general.title: Shopproof
general.description: EU rules for the countries you sell to

overview.disclaimer: Technical information to help shops comply. Not legal advice.
overview.loadFailed: The rules could not be loaded. Check that the shop can reach shopproof.app's rules file and try again.
overview.notYet: No rules file yet. Shopproof downloads it once a day; run bin/console shopproof:rules:refresh to fetch it now.
overview.countriesHint: Choose the countries you sell to under Extensions > My extensions > Shopproof EU Compliance > Configure. EU-wide rules are always shown.

withdrawal.checkFailed: The withdrawal button check could not be loaded. Try again.
withdrawal.unsupported: This Shopware version has no withdrawal button yet. Update to Shopware 6.7.9 or later to use it; Shopproof then keeps a record of every request.
withdrawal.allGood: Shopware's withdrawal button is set up in every active storefront.
withdrawal.needsWork: Shopware's withdrawal button still needs some setup.
withdrawal.where: Change these under Settings > Basic information (Legal and compliance: Show "Revoke a contract" button in footer; Shop pages: Shop page layout for revocation request) and Settings > Flow Builder. The sales channel can override each setting. Technical help, not legal advice.

check.flowActive: The flow "Online revocation request sent" is active, so emails go out
check.customerMail: The flow emails the shopper a confirmation with the request and its date and time
check.buttonOn: The withdrawal button is switched on
check.page: The button links to a withdrawal request page
check.form: That page has the withdrawal request form
check.labels: Every storefront language has the national button wording
check.labelsMissing: These storefront languages have no national button wording yet: {languages}. Set the button text under Settings > Snippets.

withdrawal.listIntro: Every request sent through Shopware's withdrawal button, kept in this shop's database so you can show when it arrived. Shopproof never receives it.
withdrawal.searchLabel: Search by email, name or order number
withdrawal.listFailed: The withdrawal requests could not be loaded. Your user needs the right to view orders.

cms.label: Shopproof product information
cms.previewText: Durability label, product safety, guarantee notice
cms.elementText: On the product page this shows the durability label, the product safety information and the EU legal guarantee notice, each where it applies. A block the buy box or the description already shows on the page is not repeated.
cms.configText: Nothing to set here. The content comes from each product and from the Shopproof settings under Extensions > My extensions > Shopproof EU Compliance > Configure.

layouts.title: Product pages
layouts.intro: Where Shopproof shows the durability label (in the buy box) and the product safety information and guarantee notice (below the product description), for each product page layout your shop uses.
layouts.missing: has no place for {blocks}. Open the layout and add the block "Shopproof product information" (category Commerce) where they should appear.

part.safety: product safety and the guarantee notice
